context: HTTP one-shot request retirement; proposed spec, not implementation or sealed tests

entities.name: CleanupSession
entities.definition: Fatal-unwind ownership coordinator. Stops normal producers; settles only after request retirement and resource release. A stalled session must not return through operand-invalidating defers.

entities.name: RequestLease
entities.definition: One logical generation of a one-shot ACCEPT, RECV, READ or SEND. Tag reuse is not identity reuse. Holds operands until terminal target completion, or proven abandonment before publication.

entities.name: ResourceLease
entities.definition: Application ownership of a descriptor or allocation. Successful ACCEPT creates a descriptor lease independently of cancellation. FD number alone is not identity; zero is a valid descriptor.

entities.name: ClientSlot
entities.definition: Stable server slot. HTTP phase, descriptor ownership and request publication are distinct facts. A slot can own an accepted descriptor before its phase leaves idle.

entities.name: ControlLease
entities.definition: Cancellation attempt with its own identity and admission/retirement state. Async control tags are distinct from application tags; synchronous return and control CQE are different evidence forms. Controls never restart HTTP work.

valueObjects.name: PublicationState
valueObjects.definition: PreparedUnpublished, Published or PublicationUncertain. An enter error after SQ-tail publication cannot revert a lease to PreparedUnpublished.

valueObjects.name: CompletionState
valueObjects.definition: Awaiting, ReadyUnread, CopiedUndispatched, Dispatched or AbandonedUnpublished. CQ advancement is not accepted-resource release.

valueObjects.name: TerminalCompletion
valueObjects.definition: A correlated terminal one-shot target CQE. Retires that operation's operand use; successful ACCEPT also creates a ResourceLease. Not a control CQE, submit count or ring-close observation.

valueObjects.name: CancellationReceipt
valueObjects.definition: Control outcome, not universal target-retirement evidence. Includes cancel CQE, synchronous canceled count, no-match, error or timeout; target completions/resource results remain separately owned.

domainEvents.name: CleanupStarted
domainEvents.definition: Normal producers and rearming are disabled.

domainEvents.name: RequestPublished
domainEvents.definition: SQE becomes visible through shared SQ-tail publication, before enter outcome is interpreted.

domainEvents.name: CompletionCopied
domainEvents.definition: CQ slot is acknowledged; copied result remains owned until dispatched or claimed by cleanup.

domainEvents.name: TargetRetired
domainEvents.definition: Terminal target completion consumed, or prepared request proven never published and abandoned.

domainEvents.name: AcceptDescriptorClaimed
domainEvents.definition: Nonnegative ACCEPT result transferred to explicit resource ownership, including FD0.

domainEvents.name: ResourceReleased
domainEvents.definition: Owned descriptor closed or allocation freed only after all retaining leases retire.

domainEvents.name: CleanupSettled
domainEvents.definition: No unresolved published lease, unclaimed accepted descriptor or retained operand remains; required controls also retired.

domainEvents.name: CleanupStalled
domainEvents.definition: Retirement cannot yet be established; preserve ownership and escalate instead of optimistic release.
